headline: A 2010 executive order created a federal council focused on disease prevention, health promotion, and public health.
what_it_does: This order set up the National Prevention, Health Promotion, and Public Health Council within the federal government. Based on its title, the council's purpose is to coordinate federal work on preventing illness, promoting health, and improving public health. No summary was provided, so details such as who sits on the council and its exact duties are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: Agencies may take part in or coordinate with the new council on prevention and public health efforts.
